events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Liverpool 0, Villarreal 1. Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom right corner.
Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Liverpool 0, Villarreal 2. Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nathan Saliba with a through ball following a fast break.
Goal! Liverpool 1, Villarreal 2. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kostas Tsimikas with a cross following a corner.
Santiago Mouriño (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Liverpool 2, Villarreal 2. Ronald Araujo (Liverpool) header from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Rio Ngumoha following a corner.
First Half ends, Liverpool 2, Villarreal 2.
Substitution, Liverpool. Florian Wirtz replaces Ronald Araujo.
Substitution, Villarreal. Tani Oluwaseyi replaces Nathan Saliba.
Second Half begins Liverpool 2, Villarreal 2.
Substitution, Villarreal. Juan Foyth replaces Alberto Moleiro.
Substitution, Villarreal. Alex Freeman replaces Tajon Buchanan.
Substitution, Villarreal. Ayoze Pérez replaces Georges Mikautadze.
Goal! Liverpool 3, Villarreal 2. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Rio Ngumoha.
Substitution, Liverpool. Alexander Isak replaces Lewis Koumas.
Goal! Liverpool 4, Villarreal 2. Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Cody Gakpo following a fast break.
Substitution, Liverpool. Bradley Barcola replaces Rio Ngumoha.
Substitution, Liverpool. Joe Gomez replaces Jérémy Jacquet.
Substitution, Villarreal. Gerard Moreno replaces Santi Comesaña.
Substitution, Liverpool. James McConnell replaces Trey Nyoni.
Goal! Liverpool 4, Villarreal 3. Tani Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ayoze Pérez with a cross.
Second Half ends, Liverpool 4, Villarreal 3.
